review.notes: Full review at an unchanged head; the previous review had no findings to repair. All 23 glue subgroups rebuilt from the printed patterns (orders, isotropy, |H|^2=|A_R|, shortest norm >= 4, root counts) and all 15 Checks recomputed; the A1^24, A2^12 and D4^6 code identifications verified against the pinned generators; Layer 6 and the K^v/K statements computed. Sample: sections 2.1-2.3, 3.1-3.3, 4.1, 5.1, 5.2, 6.1. Sources read: Conway-Sloane 1982 section 2, section 4 and Table V; Chenevier 2020 sections 5.1 (a), (c) and 5.3. SPLAG, Niemeier 1973, Wilson 2009 and Ebeling 2013 not readable (uncertified). All backticked library names resolve at the pins; none of the eight targets exists there. Suggested.lean elaborates with eight sorry warnings only; one-tactic probes close none. Dependency check: 0 problems. Automatic checks all passed on re-run. Two small corrections (a sentence in 4.1 that reads as false; 5.2 ternary half stated for permutations only) and one format note. For the humans: reuse of the Table V generator column, SPLAG unread, six row-index theorems are case analyses over pinned row theorems.
